_about: What Fieldkit needs on a machine, as data (fieldkit doctor reads it).
Born 2026-10-10: on its first run on a fresh Linux machine, the setup was worked out by hand (pytest missing, the
package not installed, rpm missing for the RPM stage). A small model would have stopped there. Python packages come
from pyproject.toml, so they are never listed twice; this file holds the programs outside Python.
tools: name -> {why, for: [what needs it], install: {debian, fedora, windows}}
for: "core" is needed by everything; a pipeline name is needed only by that pipeline.
A pipeline's own deps stage (e.g. debian-kernel's) checks its full package list; this is the short list that
lets the harness start at all.
only: "linux" or "windows" - asked for only on that system (the leak gate uses other tools on Windows).

git.why: every working copy, vault and release check is a git repository

patch.why: GNU patch 2.7 or later applies every patch set (Git for Windows ships one)

rpmbuild.why: the RPM packages of the kernel (stage rpm)

dpkg-query.why: the kernel pipeline's deps stage reads the installed Debian packages with it

install.fedora: not available: the deps stage is Debian-only
